name: Not64
author: Extrems
description_short: Nintendo 64 emulator for GameCube, Extrems' modernized fork of Mupen64GC/Wii64.
description_long: Not64 is Extrems' actively maintained Nintendo 64 emulator for GameCube, sharing the Mupen64GC/Wii64 lineage with Cube64 but consolidated into a single optimized build with updated toolchain and bug fixes. Loads .V64/.Z64/.N64 ROMs up to 512Mbit, supports dynamic recompilation or interpreter cores, hardware-accelerated graphics, native saves to Memory Card, save states, customizable button mapping, and up to 4 players.
